name: popover
title: Popover
description: Popover with a labelled × that closes it and returns focus (R15).

files.content:
import { X } from 'lucide-react' import { Popover as P } from 'radix-ui' import type { ReactNode } from 'react' import { useT } from '@/registry/i18n/i18n' import { Text } from '@/registry/patterns/text' import { IconButton } from '@/registry/ui/button' export const Popover = P.Root export const PopoverTrigger = P.Trigger /** R15: focus lands on the popover, not on ×, so the × tooltip does not open and swallow the first Esc. * × (labelled), Esc and click outside all close it; Radix returns focus to the trigger. */ export function PopoverContent({ title, children }: { title: string; children: ReactNode }) { const t = useT() return ( { e.preventDefault(); (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).focus() }} aria-label={title} sideOffset={4} collisionPadding={8} className="z-50 w-[min(24rem,calc(100vw-1rem))] rounded-md border bg-popover p-3 text-popover-foreground shadow-md">
{title}
{children} ) }
